display.name: Invoice intake
display.description: Receives invoice webhooks, holds large invoices for approval, and emails the outcome from your connected Gmail account.

requiredConnections.purpose: Tells the vendor their invoice was received, from your own Gmail account.

setup.title: Hold above
setup.description: Invoices above this amount wait for someone to approve them. Editable anytime.

setup.title: Tell the vendor at
setup.description: The vendor's accounts-receivable address. They are told their invoice was received once it is accepted, from your Gmail. Your own completion notice comes from Autom8x, not from here.

pipeline.title: Invoice received
pipeline.description: A verified webhook delivery starts a run with the invoice to intake.

pipeline.title: Check the amount
pipeline.description: Compares the invoice against your threshold and holds it if it is above.

pipeline.title: Tell the vendor
pipeline.description: Confirms receipt to the vendor from your connected Google account.
